shortDescription: Manages registration key pools on BIG-IQ

options.name: description
options.description: A description to attach to the pool.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the registration key pool. You must name your registration pools unique names. While BIG-IQ does not require this, this module does. If you do not, the behavior of the module is undefined, and you may end up putting licenses in the wrong registration key pool.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the regkey pool on the system. When C(present), guarantees the pool exists. When C(absent), removes the pool, and the licenses it contains, from the system.
